title: Evaluation of the ordered NAND tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ and $B$ be disjoint sets of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$. Given two decision trees on these coordinate sets, with inputs and outputs in $\\{ -1,1\\}$, their ordered composition evaluates on every input to $-1$ exactly when both tree outputs are $-1$, and to $1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: The first decision tree uses coordinates in $A$
The second decision tree uses coordinates in $B$
The input assigns a sign to every coordinate in $\text{Fin}(n)$
